answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the cipher until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the copper of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, re-queued for a second panel. Reaching the nebula of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
